pharmacology.text: 4,5-DHP-DMT, also known as 4,5-dihydropyrano-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a tricyclic tryptamine derivative which acts as a potent and reasonably selective partial agonist for the serotonin receptor 5-HT2A, with a Ki of 17.0 nM, and moderate selectivity over related serotonin receptors. It has lower 5-HT2 affinity and efficacy than the related compound AL-37350A, but higher lipophilicity.

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

fact.en: Compounds in this group come from research at the eye-care company Alcon, which looked for serotonin 5-HT2A activators that could lower eye pressure in glaucoma.
fact.zh: 這一類化合物來自眼科公司 Alcon 的研究，該公司當時在尋找能降低青光眼眼壓的血清素 5-HT2A 活化劑。
fact.zhHans: 这一类化合物来自眼科公司 Alcon 的研究，该公司当时在寻找能降低青光眼眼压的血清素 5-HT2A 活化剂。
